book_probe.book_sentence: After the original sequence-based transaction replacement was disabled due to the potential for abuse, a solution was proposed: programming Bitcoin Core and other relaying full node software to allow a transaction that paid a higher transaction fee rate to replace a conflicting transaction that paid a lower fee rate.
book_probe.question: What does the book say about replace by fee (RBF)?
book_probe.lead: Opt-in replace-by-fee is the policy under which a relaying node allows a transaction that pays a higher fee rate to replace a conflicting transaction that paid a lower fee rate, provided the original signalled that it may be replaced. [1]
sources: [3] Chapter ontology: a higher fee rate replaces a lower one (opt in rbf)
